defect_found_and_fixed_by_this_run.description: Global core.autocrlf=true plus '* text=auto eol=lf' normalised CRLF to LF on commit. 22 files - including all four bound inputs, abstract.md, and supplement/supplement_results.json - were therefore stored with bytes different from the ones their recorded SHA-256 values describe. The byte-binding gate refused in every fresh clone.

defect_found_and_fixed_by_this_run.fix: set '* -text -eol' and renormalize so committed bytes are the reviewed bytes
